verses.1: And a great sign appeared in the sky: a woman surrounded by the sun. The sea was beneath her feet, and on her head there were twelve stars.
verses.2: And it also exists in the stomach. It cries out in pain, and is tortured there.
verses.3: And another sign appeared in the sky. It was a giant dragon with seven heads and ten tails. On its heads, there were also seven lines.
verses.4: And his tail carried the third of the stars in the sky, and he put them into the earth. And the dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth to her child, it would devour her child.
verses.5: And he also had a son. This son would eventually bring all the nations under his rule. But his son was taken away by the gods, along with their throne.
verses.6: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where there is a place prepared by God for her to live in. There, she lived for thousands of days and sixty-six years.
verses.7: And a war took place in heaven. Michael and his angels fought against the dragon. And the dragon also fought, along with his angels.
verses.8: And they did not succeed; no place was found for them in heaven either.
verses.9: And the great dragon was thrown out, that ancient serpent, called Diabol and Satan. He who rules over the entire world was also thrown out into the earth. And his angels were also thrown out with him.
verses.10: And I heard a great voice in heaven saying, “The salvation, the power, and the kingdom of our God have come; also the authority of his cross has been revealed. For the accuser of our brothers has been condemned by God, day and night.”
verses.11: And they also defeated him through the blood of the ram, and through the testimony of their witnesses. They did not love their own souls until death came.
verses.12: Therefore, be glad, you heavens and those who reside within them. Be glad also, earth and sea, for the Devil has come down to you, filled with great anger. He knows that he has little time left.
verses.13: And when the dragon saw that it had been thrown into the ground, he became furious with the woman who had killed the serpent.
verses.14: And to the woman, the two wings of the large bird were given, so that she could fly into the desert, to the place where she lives. There, she can feed on insects at times, and sometimes not at all, depending on the weather.
verses.15: And the water flowed from his mouth towards the woman’s body, like a river, so that she would be kept under control by this “river” of water.
verses.16: And the earth was benefited by this woman. The earth opened up her mouth, and the river that the dragon had poured out from its mouth flowed through it.
verses.17: And the dragon became angry with that woman. So he left to wage war against those who obeyed God’s commands and testified about Jesus.
verses.18: And he stood on the surface of the sea.
